description: Fix espacement ALL HEARTS BEAT THE SAME.

ai_generation.positive_prompt: Circular embroidery patch on dark charcoal felt. The patch features a slogan in bold embroidered block letters on two lines: the first line reads "ALL HEARTS" and the second line reads "BEAT THE SAME" — four separate words on that line, with a clear visible space between each word, spelled correctly, every word written a single time, large and perfectly legible, stitched in clean white satin thread with a dark outline. Together with the lettering: a single continuous heartbeat pulse line crossing the patch, the line transitioning through the six rainbow colors. Thick twisted rainbow rope border around the circular patch edge. Embroidered iron-on patch, hand-sewn look, ultra-detailed macro embroidery rendering: individual thread strands clearly visible, raised stitch relief catching soft studio light, subtle textile sheen. Centered composition, full circular design entirely visible with a clear margin of dark felt all around. The patch contains no other words besides the slogan, no watermark, no logos.
